# Isolated coding investigation and candidate check

Task: root-resume 요청을 해석할 때 resume/cancel의 reservationId가 빈 문자열 또는 공백만이면 거부하도록 보완하세요. 비공백 ID는 원문 그대로 유지하고, list 요청 규칙·알 수 없는 키 거부·revision의 0 이상 safe integer 조건을 보존하세요.

Investigate the fixed read-only source snapshot, propose the smallest relevant correction, and validate your candidate with check_patch. Find the owning file yourself. Do not execute or modify the investigated scripts, copy the project, run product builds, or install anything. Actual source edits are represented only by check_patch changes; neither the shared snapshot nor the real checkout is written.

Use files/search to locate owners and read_file for the needed source ranges. Choose the evidence required for this task; whole-file reads are not required.

Only read this guide and use this lane's client for every source query and candidate check. No direct shell/source/helper/verifier/runtime reads, other lanes, internet or delegation. Preserve concurrent work. No file/line/character/selection budget is imposed. Expand evidence when a concrete gap remains. Do not force the answer to favor a tool.

Common API:
- files({glob?:fnmatch_glob}) lists only snapshot source paths; '*' can match '/'.
- search({pattern:rg_regex,relative_path?:file_or_dir,glob?:rg_glob,context?:nonnegative_integer}) runs actual rg with line numbers and context. No match is normal.
- read_file({relative_path,start_line?:1_based,end_line?:inclusive}) returns only those original lines with 1-based labels and original line endings. Omitted range means whole file.
- check_patch({changes:[{relative_path,old_text,new_text},...]}) applies all changes in memory against ORIGINAL frozen source on EVERY call. Checks are NOT cumulative. Each nonempty old_text must occur exactly once in the original; overlapping changes and changes outside the task's single authorized source file are rejected. Preserve exact old_text, including line endings, or use a sufficiently specific single-line fragment. The response gives passed/fail, causal first failure, case counts, check_id and candidate_sha256. You may refine and check again. The verifier executes extracted actual implementation functions/callbacks with fixed unit cases; it does not prove a complete build, live browser/Electron behavior, visual appearance or mobile support.
This base condition does not expose list_ids/read_symbols. Do not call them.

PowerShell UTF-8 request (ONE JSON per invocation):

```powershell
$OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false)
@'
{"tool":"files","arguments":{}}
'@ | node C:/Users/felre/Desktop/pi-harness-init/artifacts/verification/minimal-id-frontend-eval-20261103-a93b207c/client.cjs code_base1
```

Independent source queries may run together, each via a separate client invocation. Before finishing, obtain a passed check_patch for the final changes. Then call task_complete with arguments {changes:[...],candidate_sha256:"the matching last passed hash",explanation:...,evidence:[...],uncertainty:...}. The final changes must regenerate exactly the last passed candidate hash. No cumulative or unverified final patch. Return a concise Korean explanation of the correction and checks, without claiming product execution or visual validation. Root owns measurements, independent grading and cleanup.
